package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

const (
	probeBodyLimit       = 1 << 20
	probeScreenshotLimit = 8 << 20
	registryBodyLimit    = 16 << 10
	listServicesPath     = "/rpc"
	listServicesBody     = `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"list_services","arguments":{}}}`
	toolsListPath        = "/rpc/agent"
	toolsListBody        = `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}`
	statusPath           = "/statusz?format=json"
)

type handlerProbeCheck struct {
	Scenario string `json:"scenario"`
	Name     string `json:"name"`
	Pass     bool   `json:"pass"`
	Detail   string `json:"detail,omitempty"`
}

type handlerProbeRequest struct {
	Scenario  string `json:"scenario"`
	Surface   string `json:"surface"`
	Method    string `json:"method"`
	Path      string `json:"path"`
	Operation string `json:"operation,omitempty"`
}

type handlerProbeReport struct {
	mu       sync.Mutex
	Checks   []handlerProbeCheck   `json:"checks"`
	Requests []handlerProbeRequest `json:"requests"`
	Failures []string              `json:"failures"`
}

func (p *handlerProbeReport) check(scenario, name string, pass bool, detail string) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	p.Checks = append(p.Checks, handlerProbeCheck{Scenario: scenario, Name: name, Pass: pass, Detail: detail})
	if !pass {
		p.Failures = append(p.Failures, scenario+": "+name)
	}
}

func (p *handlerProbeReport) request(r handlerProbeRequest) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	p.Requests = append(p.Requests, r)
	p.mu.Unlock()
}

func (p *handlerProbeReport) counts(scenario string) map[string]int {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	out := map[string]int{}
	for _, r := range p.Requests {
		if r.Scenario == scenario && r.Surface == "registry" {
			out[r.Operation]++
		}
	}
	return out
}

type allowlistedTransport struct {
	base     *http.Transport
	report   *handlerProbeReport
	mu       sync.RWMutex
	hosts    map[string]bool
	scenario string
}

func (a *allowlistedTransport) allow(rawURL, scenario string) error {
	u, err := url.Parse(rawURL)
	if err != nil || u.Scheme != "http" || u.Host == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid allowlisted loopback URL")
	}
	a.mu.Lock()
	a.hosts[u.Host] = true
	a.scenario = scenario
	a.mu.Unlock()
	return nil
}

func (a *allowlistedTransport) RoundTrip(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	a.mu.RLock()
	ok := r.URL.Scheme == "http" && a.hosts[r.URL.Host]
	scenario := a.scenario
	a.mu.RUnlock()
	if !ok {
		a.report.check(scenario, "outbound transport refuses every unapproved host", false, r.Method+" "+r.URL.Scheme+"://"+r.URL.Host+r.URL.Path)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("handler probe refused outbound host %q", r.URL.Host)
	}
	return a.base.RoundTrip(r)
}

type boundedWriter struct {
	buf      bytes.Buffer
	max      int
	overflow bool
}

func (w *boundedWriter) Write(b []byte) (int, error) {
	n := len(b)
	remain := w.max - w.buf.Len()
	if remain > 0 {
		if remain > n {
			remain = n
		}
		_, _ = w.buf.Write(b[:remain])
	}
	if n > remain {
		w.overflow = true
	}
	return n, nil
}

func TestAppkitActualObservatoryHandlerProbe(t *testing.T) {
	root := os.Getenv("APPKIT_FATHOM_HANDLER_REPORT_ROOT")
	if !filepath.IsAbs(root) {
		t.Fatal("APPKIT_FATHOM_HANDLER_REPORT_ROOT must name an absolute empty private directory")
	}
	info, err := os.Stat(root)
	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() || info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
		t.Fatal("APPKIT_FATHOM_HANDLER_REPORT_ROOT must be an existing private directory")
	}
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(root)
	if err != nil || len(entries) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("APPKIT_FATHOM_HANDLER_REPORT_ROOT must be empty")
	}
	report := &handlerProbeReport{}
	defer func() {
		data, marshalErr := json.MarshalIndent(report, "", "  ")
		if marshalErr == nil {
			var out *os.File
			out, marshalErr = os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(root, "http-report.json"), os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
			if marshalErr == nil {
				_, marshalErr = out.Write(append(data, '\n'))
				if closeErr := out.Close(); marshalErr == nil {
					marshalErr = closeErr
				}
			}
		}
		if marshalErr != nil {
			t.Errorf("write bounded handler report: %v", marshalErr)
		}
		if len(report.Failures) != 0 {
			t.Errorf("actual handler probe recorded %d failure(s)", len(report.Failures))
		}
	}()

	base, ok := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("http.DefaultTransport is not the standard transport")
	}
	transport := &allowlistedTransport{base: base.Clone(), report: report, hosts: map[string]bool{}}
	transport.base.Proxy = nil
	previousTransport := http.DefaultTransport
	http.DefaultTransport = transport
	defer func() {
		http.DefaultTransport = previousTransport
		transport.base.CloseIdleConnections()
	}()

	for _, scenario := range []string{"registry-unavailable", "pathless-service"} {
		runActualHandlerScenario(t, report, transport, root, scenario)
	}
}

func runActualHandlerScenario(t *testing.T, report *handlerProbeReport, transport *allowlistedTransport, root, scenario string) {
	t.Helper()
	envRoot := hermeticObsEnv(t)
	callLogDir := filepath.Join(envRoot, "empty-call-log-directory")
	if err := os.Mkdir(callLogDir, 0o700); err != nil {
		report.check(scenario, "create unreadable call-log fixture", false, err.Error())
		return
	}
	t.Setenv("FATHOM_CALL_LOG", callLogDir)
	resetObsCache()

	registry := httptest.NewServer(actualRegistryFixture(report, scenario))
	defer registry.Close()
	if err := transport.allow(registry.URL, scenario); err != nil {
		report.check(scenario, "allow registry origin", false, err.Error())
		return
	}
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.Handle("/", landingHandler(registry.URL))
	mux.Handle("/observatory", observatoryHandler(registry.URL))
	mux.Handle("/observatory/service", observatoryServicePage(registry.URL))
	mux.Handle("/assets/app.css", assetsHandler())
	ui := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		report.request(handlerProbeRequest{Scenario: scenario, Surface: "ui", Method: r.Method, Path: r.URL.RequestURI()})
		mux.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	}))
	defer ui.Close()
	if err := transport.allow(ui.URL, scenario); err != nil {
		report.check(scenario, "allow UI origin", false, err.Error())
		return
	}

	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second}
	home := probeHandlerURL(report, scenario, client, http.MethodGet, ui.URL+"/", http.StatusOK, "text/html")
	fleet := probeHandlerURL(report, scenario, client, http.MethodGet, ui.URL+"/observatory", http.StatusOK, "text/html")
	wantService := http.StatusNotFound
	if scenario == "pathless-service" {
		wantService = http.StatusOK
	}
	service := probeHandlerURL(report, scenario, client, http.MethodGet, ui.URL+"/observatory/service?id=alpha", wantService, map[bool]string{true: "text/html", false: "text/plain"}[wantService == http.StatusOK])
	back := probeHandlerURL(report, scenario, client, http.MethodGet, ui.URL+"/", http.StatusOK, "text/html")
	css := probeHandlerURL(report, scenario, client, http.MethodGet, ui.URL+"/assets/app.css", http.StatusOK, "text/css")
	var serviceJSON string
	if scenario == "pathless-service" {
		serviceJSON = probeHandlerURL(report, scenario, client, http.MethodGet, ui.URL+"/observatory/service?id=alpha&format=json", http.StatusOK, "application/json")
	}
	for _, path := range []string{"/", "/observatory", "/observatory/service?id=alpha"} {
		probeHandlerURL(report, scenario, client, http.MethodPost, ui.URL+path, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "text/plain")
	}
	probeHandlerURL(report, scenario, client, http.MethodGet, ui.URL+"/unknown", http.StatusNotFound, "text/plain")
	probeHandlerURL(report, scenario, client, http.MethodGet, ui.URL+"/observatory/service?id=missing", http.StatusNotFound, "text/plain")

	report.check(scenario, "landing and back retain the same model", home != "" && home == back, "")
	report.check(scenario, "actual kit-built CSS returned byte-for-byte", len(css) > 1024 && bytes.Equal([]byte(css), obsAppCSS), fmt.Sprintf("bytes=%d", len(css)))
	if scenario == "registry-unavailable" {
		named := strings.Contains(home, "service registry unreachable") && strings.Contains(fleet, "fleet tiles are not measured, never empty-as-healthy")
		report.check(scenario, "503 registry failure is named, not rendered healthy", named, "")
		report.check(scenario, "unavailable registry invents no service detail links", !strings.Contains(home+fleet, "/observatory/service?id="), "")
	} else {
		named := strings.Contains(fleet, ">alpha<") && strings.Contains(fleet, "/observatory/service?id=alpha") && strings.Contains(service, "unknown: no recorded corpus path")
		report.check(scenario, "pathless one-symbol service remains navigable", named, "")
		absent := strings.Contains(service, "no recorded corpus path") && strings.Contains(service, "configuration not inspectable") && strings.Contains(service, "not inspectable") && !strings.Contains(service, "0 pre-edit warnings configured")
		report.check(scenario, "pathless configuration is named absent, not zero", absent, "")
		var observed struct {
			Service string `json:"service"`
			Path    string `json:"path"`
			Symbols int    `json:"symbols"`
			Config  struct {
				LayersNote  string `json:"layers_note"`
				GuardNote   string `json:"guard_note"`
				BindingNote string `json:"binding_note"`
			} `json:"config"`
		}
		err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(serviceJSON), &observed)
		exact := err == nil && observed.Service == "alpha" && observed.Path == "" && observed.Symbols == 1 &&
			strings.Contains(observed.Config.LayersNote, "not inspectable") && observed.Config.GuardNote == "not inspectable" && observed.Config.BindingNote == "not inspectable"
		report.check(scenario, "service JSON retains exact pathless registry identity", exact, "")
	}

	counts := report.counts(scenario)
	if scenario == "registry-unavailable" {
		report.check(scenario, "registry retry is exactly two bounded list_services calls", counts["list_services"] == 2 && len(counts) == 1, fmt.Sprint(counts))
	} else {
		report.check(scenario, "successful model uses only exact registry operations", counts["list_services"] == 1 && counts["statusz"] == 1 && counts["tools/list"] == 1 && len(counts) == 3, fmt.Sprint(counts))
	}
	runActualHandlerBrowser(report, scenario, ui.URL, root)
}

func actualRegistryFixture(report *handlerProbeReport, scenario string) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		op := "unknown"
		if r.Method == http.MethodGet && r.URL.RequestURI() == statusPath {
			op = "statusz"
		} else if r.Method == http.MethodPost && r.URL.RawQuery == "" {
			body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, registryBodyLimit+1))
			if err == nil && len(body) <= registryBodyLimit {
				switch {
				case r.URL.Path == listServicesPath && string(body) == listServicesBody:
					op = "list_services"
				case r.URL.Path == toolsListPath && string(body) == toolsListBody:
					op = "tools/list"
				}
			}
		}
		report.request(handlerProbeRequest{Scenario: scenario, Surface: "registry", Method: r.Method, Path: r.URL.RequestURI(), Operation: op})
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		switch {
		case op == "list_services" && scenario == "registry-unavailable":
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"error":"synthetic registry unavailable"}`)
		case op == "list_services":
			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"services":[{"service":"alpha","symbol_count":1,"languages":["Go"],"path":""}]}}`)
		case op == "statusz" && scenario == "pathless-service":
			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"services":[]}`)
		case op == "tools/list" && scenario == "pathless-service":
			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"tools":[]}}`)
		default:
			report.check(scenario, "registry refused unknown request", false, r.Method+" "+r.URL.RequestURI()+" "+op)
			http.Error(w, `{"error":"refused"}`, http.StatusForbidden)
		}
	})
}

func probeHandlerURL(report *handlerProbeReport, scenario string, client *http.Client, method, target string, want int, contentType string) string {
	req, err := http.NewRequest(method, target, nil)
	if err != nil {
		report.check(scenario, method+" request constructed", false, err.Error())
		return ""
	}
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		report.check(scenario, method+" "+req.URL.RequestURI(), false, err.Error())
		return ""
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	body, readErr := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, probeBodyLimit+1))
	bounded := readErr == nil && len(body) <= probeBodyLimit
	report.check(scenario, method+" "+req.URL.RequestURI()+" status", resp.StatusCode == want, fmt.Sprintf("want=%d got=%d", want, resp.StatusCode))
	report.check(scenario, method+" "+req.URL.RequestURI()+" bounded body", bounded, fmt.Sprintf("bytes=%d", len(body)))
	report.check(scenario, method+" "+req.URL.RequestURI()+" content type", strings.HasPrefix(resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"), contentType), resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if !bounded {
		return ""
	}
	return string(body)
}

func runActualHandlerBrowser(report *handlerProbeReport, scenario, origin, root string) {
	script := os.Getenv("APPKIT_FATHOM_HANDLER_BROWSER")
	if script == "" {
		report.check(scenario, "browser probe is explicitly configured", false, "APPKIT_FATHOM_HANDLER_BROWSER is empty")
		return
	}
	module := os.Getenv("APPKIT_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE")
	if !filepath.IsAbs(script) || !filepath.IsAbs(module) {
		report.check(scenario, "browser inputs are absolute", false, "")
		return
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(script); err != nil {
		report.check(scenario, "browser script exists", false, err.Error())
		return
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(module); err != nil {
		report.check(scenario, "approved Playwright module exists", false, err.Error())
		return
	}
	outDir := filepath.Join(root, scenario+"-browser")
	if err := os.Mkdir(outDir, 0o700); err != nil {
		report.check(scenario, "create fresh browser report directory", false, err.Error())
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 90*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "node", script, origin, scenario, outDir, module)
	stdout, stderr := &boundedWriter{max: probeBodyLimit}, &boundedWriter{max: probeBodyLimit}
	cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = stdout, stderr
	err := cmd.Run()
	if ctx.Err() != nil {
		err = ctx.Err()
	}
	if err != nil || stdout.overflow || stderr.overflow {
		report.check(scenario, "bounded browser child succeeds", false, fmt.Sprintf("error=%v stdout_bytes=%d stderr_bytes=%d", err, stdout.buf.Len(), stderr.buf.Len()))
		return
	}
	var child struct {
		Scenario  string   `json:"scenario"`
		Checks    int      `json:"checks"`
		Failures  []string `json:"failures"`
		Completed int      `json:"completed"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(bytes.TrimSpace(stdout.buf.Bytes()), &child); err != nil {
		report.check(scenario, "browser child emits one bounded JSON receipt", false, fmt.Sprintf("bytes=%d", stdout.buf.Len()))
		return
	}
	stdoutPass := child.Scenario == scenario && child.Checks > 0 && len(child.Failures) == 0 && child.Completed == 4
	report.check(scenario, "browser child stdout is only a successful bounded summary", stdoutPass, fmt.Sprintf("checks=%d completed=%d failures=%d", child.Checks, child.Completed, len(child.Failures)))

	data, err := boundedRegularFile(filepath.Join(outDir, "browser-report.json"), probeBodyLimit)
	if err != nil {
		report.check(scenario, "persisted browser report is bounded and regular", false, err.Error())
		return
	}
	var persisted struct {
		Scenario string `json:"scenario"`
		Origin   string `json:"origin"`
		Source   struct {
			File   string `json:"file"`
			SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
		} `json:"source"`
		Checks []struct {
			Name string `json:"name"`
			Pass bool   `json:"pass"`
		} `json:"checks"`
		Failures      []string          `json:"failures"`
		Blocked       []json.RawMessage `json:"blocked"`
		PageErrors    []string          `json:"pageErrors"`
		ConsoleErrors []string          `json:"consoleErrors"`
		Screenshots   []struct {
			File   string `json:"file"`
			SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
		} `json:"screenshots"`
		DetailScreenshots []struct {
			File   string `json:"file"`
			SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
		} `json:"detailScreenshots"`
		Cases []struct {
			Theme    string `json:"theme"`
			Width    int    `json:"width"`
			Finished bool   `json:"finished"`
		} `json:"cases"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &persisted); err != nil {
		report.check(scenario, "persisted browser report is valid JSON", false, err.Error())
		return
	}
	scriptSHA, err := boundedRegularFileSHA(script, probeBodyLimit)
	sourceOK := err == nil && persisted.Source.File == "browser.mjs" && persisted.Source.SHA256 == scriptSHA
	report.check(scenario, "browser report binds the current browser source", sourceOK, "")
	report.check(scenario, "browser report binds exact scenario and origin", persisted.Scenario == scenario && persisted.Origin == origin, "")
	checksOK := len(persisted.Checks) > 0
	for _, check := range persisted.Checks {
		checksOK = checksOK && check.Name != "" && check.Pass
	}
	clean := len(persisted.Failures) == 0 && len(persisted.Blocked) == 0 && len(persisted.PageErrors) == 0 && len(persisted.ConsoleErrors) == 0
	report.check(scenario, "every persisted browser check passes", checksOK, fmt.Sprintf("checks=%d", len(persisted.Checks)))
	report.check(scenario, "persisted browser report has no failures or blocked traffic", clean, "")

	wantCases := map[string]bool{"light/390": false, "light/1440": false, "dark/390": false, "dark/1440": false}
	casesOK := len(persisted.Cases) == len(wantCases)
	for _, c := range persisted.Cases {
		key := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", c.Theme, c.Width)
		if _, exists := wantCases[key]; !exists || wantCases[key] || !c.Finished {
			casesOK = false
		} else {
			wantCases[key] = true
		}
	}
	for _, seen := range wantCases {
		casesOK = casesOK && seen
	}
	report.check(scenario, "persisted browser cases are four unique finished theme-width journeys", casesOK, "")

	wantShots := map[string]bool{}
	for _, theme := range []string{"light", "dark"} {
		for _, width := range []int{320, 390, 1440} {
			wantShots[fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-%d.png", scenario, theme, width)] = false
		}
	}
	shotsOK := len(persisted.Screenshots) == 4 && len(persisted.DetailScreenshots) == 2
	for _, shot := range append(persisted.Screenshots, persisted.DetailScreenshots...) {
		safe := !filepath.IsAbs(shot.File) && filepath.Base(shot.File) == shot.File && filepath.Clean(shot.File) == shot.File
		seen, expected := wantShots[shot.File]
		if !safe || !expected || seen {
			shotsOK = false
			continue
		}
		digest, hashErr := boundedRegularFileSHA(filepath.Join(outDir, shot.File), probeScreenshotLimit)
		if hashErr != nil || digest != shot.SHA256 {
			shotsOK = false
			continue
		}
		wantShots[shot.File] = true
	}
	for _, seen := range wantShots {
		shotsOK = shotsOK && seen
	}
	report.check(scenario, "four journey and two 320px screenshot hashes match actual bytes", shotsOK, "")
}

func boundedRegularFile(path string, limit int64) ([]byte, error) {
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() > limit {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("refused non-regular or oversized file")
	}
	f, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(f, limit+1))
	if err != nil || int64(len(data)) > limit {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("bounded file read failed")
	}
	return data, nil
}

func boundedRegularFileSHA(path string, limit int64) (string, error) {
	data, err := boundedRegularFile(path, limit)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
	return fmt.Sprintf("%x", digest), nil
}
